title: golden session 1: the first hour (adolion-academy, Artemis)
objective: v2.8 24 golden session GS1. One adolion-fresh lane with Artemis v1.1 on the 3090 (or a pod lane), shipped defaults: thinking and inner voice on, judge on TypeSafe, authoring on the default Sol route, images and sprites off. Story adolion-academy in its own group, picked by id; nothing here names campaign content: checkpoints are chosen by structure at run time and player lines are generic. 16 real player turns. Run twice back to back on one lane, run 2 from the seeded lane snapshot taken before run 1 (24 §Rules 5). Each check names the feature and manifest rows it closes (24 §Golden sessions). Written, validated by the loader, not run yet: the first run is a shakedown, not evidence.

Closes: features stories, group-binding, story-briefing, briefing-draft (real draft on the authoring route), player-setup; rows 34-RP (start setup, persona in the first prompt), 34-L-flow/34-L-fixed live, S-06 (role line once), O1 start half. Briefing and identity step are switched back on for this check (so-journey suppresses them by default) and restored by cleanup.
